name: app-car-wash-onboarding-with-flat-purple-illustrations
title: Three white screens with flat purple illustrations: car wash on demand, choose a service and enjoy the journey
whatItIs: Three phones on grey tilted at angles, each with a flat isometric illustration in magenta and purple (a woman by a car, a mechanic with an open hood, friends in a convertible), a bold black title, a grey description, pager dots and a purple Next pill with a swipe arrow.
whatItMeans: Simple and friendly; consistent flat illustrations make services approachable.
techniques: Place a bold title and short line under each.
Use a pill Next with a swipe track.

vocabulary.definition: A flat drawing in angled 3D view.
A button with a slider hint.
